requirement.description: Layout classes (StructLayout, UnionLayout, ArrayLayout, FlexibleLayout) are missing proper __int__ method implementation, causing TypeError when attempting to convert layout objects to integers. This affects multiple tests in test_lib_data.py.
requirement.contract: Layout classes must implement __int__ method that returns the size of the layout. The method should return an integer representing the total bit width of the layout.

requirement.description: IOPort class has issues with transformation and validation, causing "Cannot transform value (io-port None)" errors in multiple IR tests. This affects tests in test_hdl_ir.py and test_hdl_ast.py.
requirement.contract: IOPort objects must properly support transformation to IR representation. The __repr__ method should correctly format IOPort instances and validation should occur during construction to prevent None values in required fields.

requirement.description: View class is missing proper attribute access validation and error message formatting. Tests fail due to incorrect error messages for missing attributes and reserved names.
requirement.contract: View class must provide proper error messages for attribute access. When accessing non-existent fields, it should return clear error messages with suggested alternatives. When accessing reserved field names, it should provide appropriate error messages.

requirement.description: Const class is missing proper from_bits method implementation and has incorrect error message formatting for layout validation.
requirement.contract: Const class must implement from_bits method and provide accurate error messages for layout validation. Error messages should match the expected format exactly.

requirement.description: Struct class is missing proper from_bits method implementation and has issues with error handling for invalid constructors.
requirement.contract: Struct class must implement from_bits method and provide appropriate error handling for constructor arguments. It should properly validate input shapes and provide meaningful error messages.
